title: [Docs] Clean up historical Agent-Medici references
body:
## Context The repo has historical references to `Agent-Medici` (the predecessor project) in several docs and scripts. PR #515 fixed one instance in `docs/agents/node-injection.md`, but more remain. ## Files to Check - `AGENTS.md` - `docs/agents/knowledge-structure.md` - `docs/human/intuitive-flow-setup.md` - Legacy hub scripts/docs - Any other references to `Agent-Medici`, `agent-medici`, `~/Agent-Medici` ## What to Do 1. Search the repo for all `Agent-Medici` / `agent-medici` references 2. For each instance, determine: - Is this a path reference? → Update to `MisakaNet` - Is this a project name reference? → Update to `MisakaNet` or remove - Is this historical context? → Leave as-is or add a note that it's legacy 3. Do NOT change git history or commit messages 4. Do NOT modify files under `lessons/` (lessons may legitimately reference the old name) ## Acceptance Criteria - [ ] No active path references to `Agent-Medici` remain in docs or scripts - [ ] Historical mentions are either updated or clearly marked as legacy - [ ] All links pointing to `Agent-Medici` repos are updated - [ ] No lessons are modified (they may reference the old name legitimately) ## Notes This is a cleanup task, not urgent. PR #515's `node-injection.md` fix is the most important one (it's the public onboarding doc). The rest can be done incrementally.
